_what: C-STRUCT J1 gate-surface successor. CSTRUCT-priority-reorder-J1-FRESH-2STANCE-SOURCE-ORIENT에서 정확히 한 configuration lever만 바꾼다: GATE_QUESTION only. ORIENT baseline은 stance를 4:6으로 갈랐지만 여섯 개의 b 모두 utterance에서는 신원·출처 질문으로 나왔다 (A15 legibility failure). caller-facing 첫 마디 대신 상황실을 향한 첫 지시를 묻는 게이트로 바꿔, 검증/선제가 같은 output field에서 서로 다른 행동으로 실현되게 한다. STANCE_SET, PRIORITY_LIST 문구와 순서, 세 arm permutation, TIMELINE_EXCERPT, empty BLOCKS, FLAW/INCIDENT, K1, base, model, output schema는 byte-identical하다. 게이트를 바꾸면 baseline이 리셋되므로 이 suite는 baseline N10 calibration부터 시작하며 이전 표본을 합치지 않는다.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At the J1 first-dispatch gate under K1 on template v0.4, with cost-bearing stance orientations and the gate moved to the situation-room order, moving actual-danger delay goal B above source-grounding goal A shifts the stance distribution toward 선제 (b), while reordering only reporting principles C/D leaves the placebo distribution near baseline.
pre_registration.drop_condition: Run baseline only as calibration. Drop this configuration without spending live/placebo calls if ANY of: (1) baseline selects the predicted live stance b >=8/10 (A14 ceiling); (2) baseline selects b <=2/10 (floor — the mirror case that cost 69 calls in J1-A and J1-FRESH); (3) the two stances still produce the same utterance form, i.e. fewer than 8/10 utterances are classifiable as an a-type order (trace/record/confirm-source) vs a b-type order (dispatch/stage/prepare) by their imperative alone (A15); (4) fewer than 8/10 decisive reasons name the cost ordering the chosen stance claims. Only if none fire, author an independent comparison suite whose N is sized for 80% power at a pre-stated MDE — not N10, not N20.
contingencies: MDE gate (new, corrects the predecessor's N20 error). Before authoring any comparison, compute the minimum live count that reaches one-sided Fisher p<=0.05 against the measured baseline, and the power of the planned N. At baseline b6/10 and N10 per arm, only live b10/10 reaches p<=0.05 (p=0.0433); at baseline b14/20 and N20 per arm, only live b>=19/20 does (p=0.0457). Both designs can only detect a >=25pp effect. Powering a 0.50->0.70 or 0.60->0.80 shift at 80% needs roughly N=80-100 per arm. Do not spend a comparison that cannot see the effect it hypothesizes.

Placebo is reported two-sided, not one-sided toward b. A placebo that moves AWAY from b by as much as live moved is a validity warning, not a clean null: the predecessor's live moved -10pp and its placebo -15pp, and the one-sided p=0.90460 concealed that.

Discard rate is defined as discarded / total attempts for that arm, and both the rate and the STANCE TALLY OF THE DISCARDED PAYLOADS are reported per arm. Discards in this series are not stance-neutral (J1-FRESH: 9/9 discards were the modal stance c; J1-A: 6/6 were c or d), and retry-until-N-valid therefore resamples away from whichever stance emits malformed output. This is the RB1 bias recorded in A9. If discard rates differ by more than 15 percentage points, or the discarded stance tally differs in direction from the kept tally, the arms are incomparable.

This is the 8th configuration searched against essentially one hypothesis. Any nominal p<=0.05 obtained here is a discovery, not a result: it must be replicated in an independent, separately pre-registered confirmation run before it may be cited as C-STRUCT evidence.
Code K1's explicit fear reading separately. If fear reading still determines b regardless of priority order, record temperament dominance rather than attributing movement to C-STRUCT.
If b appears only as 'dispatch a team in order to verify the claim', the delay cost was never accepted and the escape path survived the gate change. Record it and stop rather than raising N.

The output schema has no structured priority-id citation. Priority use is coded manually from inner_note and rejected_reason. Fabricated because_block_ids in these empty-block arms remain A5 compliance data, not C-STRUCT trace evidence.
Manual belief/stance-realization coding by the probe author is calibration-grade only. A verdict card requires an independent B3a blind coder.
pre_registration.not_claimed: This is a baseline calibration for one gate-question rewrite, not C-STRUCT evidence. It does not test live/placebo attribution, priority depth, returning-run survival, C-BLOCK interaction, in-situ deltas, player discoverability, or official program validity before the negative control.
